entries.summary: On a host, run session claim from the host root after docs/active_state.json exists; session_start --boot resolves repo_root to .agents and must not be treated as the host Zero Coordinate.
Cursor PreToolUse hooks must emit {"permission":"allow|deny"} on stdout; wrap on_commit.py so its prose goes to stderr.
Do not seal an Accepted structure ADR or execute layout changes until the human has debated product shape in chat; a premature ADR must be reverted and the plan returned to DRAFT.
Casual OK is not Approval Gate while the human is still clarifying product intent; keep IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN in DRAFT and stay in chat until they ask to redact the project plan.
Under Cursor PreToolUse, stage files (and fix-regression tests) in one Bash call, then run git commit alone in a later call — the gate reads the index before the compound command executes.

Never theorize about a third-party DOM: write a probe that dumps the real attribute chain first, because three successive selector hypotheses for WhatsApp message direction were each wrong and each shipped.
Verify an export by field integrity, not by message count: 217 messages looked like success while 214 of them carried a clock in sender and body text in timestamp.
A harvest that stops without positive proof of the chat start must report complete:false; treating a stall as completion produced a truncated corpus labelled complete.

Never build a click target from broad selectors such as a or [tabindex] inside content: scope to panel chrome and reject any node inside a message bubble, or the harvester clicks links in the operator's live session.
Playwright needs the real filesystem: under the agent sandbox Chromium fails to create its ProcessSingleton socket, so live browser runs must be issued outside it.

Phases that leave no artifact are invisible until a gate reads for them: Sprint 005 skipped Phase 3 and 4.1-4.3, and close Phase 2.6 was the only detector - jurisdictional_lock and no_interference were disabled while appearing enforced.

Verify a plan's stated rationale against its own acceptance criteria before executing it: Sprint 005's W5 claimed adding kind to the fallback hash would separate two voice notes that share kind, sender, minute and empty body, which it cannot.

Read probe output for what it contains rather than scanning it for the expected signal: the kind probe answered its question and also revealed emoji-only messages drawn as img alt, a loss larger than the media it was written for.

open_chat_by_query reports success without opening the requested chat - it clicks an unfiltered chat-list item and waits on a panel selector already satisfied when a conversation is open, so an export can be written for the wrong chat and exit 0.
